contea di ritrovamento: Nottinghamshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

: Copper alloy Coin. Nummus, probably of House of Valentinian, possibly Securitas Rei Publicae issue of 364-378, Reece period 19. Obverse description: Bust. Reverse description: possibly Victory advancing left. Reverse inscription: [SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE]. Cliff Reeves kindly examined this coin. Diameter: 16.0mm, Weight: 0.77gms, die axis: possibly 12
